notes: Night Harvest 1.4.3: ripe wheat is visible again, animals graze, peck and hop when they stand still, no more rocks inside trees, doors and gates work from both sides, and a new logo.
Night Harvest 1.4.2: wooden bridges, a 1x2 bed, 1-block anvil and furnace, smoother boats that face where you row, the Sunforged Greatsword, and the Rotting Giant now burns in sunlight.
Night Harvest 1.4: Seasons & Seas. Four seasons, oceans and islands, boats, fishing, new villages and ruins, biome blocks, animals, decorations, a new workbench, rebindable controls and many fixes.
